name: novelty-bench-llm-judge
description: A dataset intended to evaluate model ability to judge or rank novelty of generated text (or candidate outputs) relative to references, using human judgments as ground truth. It provides pairwise or scalar novelty annotations to train or evaluate automated judge models. The benchmark is used to measure how well an automatic judge aligns with human assessments of novelty.
evaluation_method: human_eval (agreement with human judgments) / accuracy of predicted pairwise preferences
reputation: A niche evaluation dataset used for research on automated judges and novelty assessment with limited but growing visibility in evaluation-methodology work.
